text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d r-f-i-d c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s-t-i-c-k-e-r s, m-r-g-e-d the a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s in-t-o a c-l-i-p-p-o-n h-o-l-d-e-r, and b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d the h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e p-r-o-v-i-s-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) they i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a c-a-p-t-u-r-e d-r-o-n-e s-t-u-d-i-o in a v-e-n-t s-h-a-f-t, r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-h-e b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e of a t-a-r-g-e-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-l-u-r-r-y v-i-d-e-o m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the f-a-c-e-q-u-a-l-i-t-y s-c-o-r-e t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d.
3) the o-p-e-r-a-t-o-r c-l-o-n-e-d the f-a-c-e t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e in-t-o a m-a-s-k m-ol-d a-n-d a c-h-i-p e-m-u-l-a-t-o-r, s-a-v-i-n-g the b-r-a-w n-od-e h-e-x d-u-m-p, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d the l-i-v-e-n-e-s-s c-h-a-l-l-e-n-g-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) a-s-s-a-i-l-a-n-t a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d e-n-t-r-y u-s-i-n-g the s-t-o-l-e-n t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e, w-h-i-c-h w-r-o-t-e a n-o-r-m-a-l e-n-t-r-y l-o-g e-n-t-r-y, a-n-d d-e-l-e-t-e-d the s-e-n-s-o-r c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d.
5) f-i-n-a-l-l-y, t-h-e-y i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d a c-h-a-n-g-e-d t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p a-n-d a u-s-e-r i-d a-g-i-n-s-t the a-u-d-i-t l-o-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a f-o-r-g-e-d j-o-u-r-n-a-l b-a-c-k-u-p, a-n-d n-e-g-l-e-c-t-e-d the c-r-o-s-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e with the b-a-d-g-e s-c-a-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y.
